## Contract proposal for coordinator reconciliation

- `CONTENT_VERSION = 'expedition.2'`, `SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2`. Same journal key/format, writer lock, awaited detached snapshots, cancellation/disposal and request-scoped entry permission. No persistence fallback weakened.
- `GameState` now contains opening, inventory/container/equipment identities, knowledge/provenance/crafted history, depletion/reserve/facilities/bound maintenance/threat/actions, vehicle investment/cargo/berths, recovery cache/loss/local-operation identity, route metrics and migration feedback. See `src/sim/types.ts` for exact structural types.
- Production registry additionally exports `ITEMS`, `BLUEPRINTS`, `RECIPES`, `SOURCES`, `EVIDENCE`, `OPTIONAL_RECORD`, `DART_BUILD_POSE`, `RECOVERY_STAGE`, `CANOPY_COVER`, `THREAT_HOME`, `OPENING` and their typed IDs. One runtime authority; proposal JSON is checker input only.
- `stepGame` remains the fixed-step authority. `executeCommand` runs the same validated transactions while menus freeze world time. `WorldQueries.clearance` and `moveHull` add clearance/continuous terrain-and-solid movement. Diver pose is capsule base. Personal pressure reference is base+0.4 m; airway is base+0.85 m swimming or +1.55 m walking; hull depth uses keel+0.5 m. Render eye interpolation has no survival authority.
- `fixtureGame`, `carrierCommand`, `updateBerth`, `localToWorld`, `worldToLocal`, `BERTH_LOCAL`, `LAUNCH_LOCAL` establish the simplified carrier seam. Station keeping precedes walking/launch. Attached craft have explicit `carrier-local` poses and independent cargo/charge/damage. Prepared/lock transactions commit exactly once or roll back; no underway walking is claimed.
- `ExpeditionSession.newGame(scenario = 'expedition')` accepts the explicit separate fixture scenario. App retains the accepted async lifecycle and adds paused gameplay panels, command dispatch and locally generated audio. UI has no state setters or debug completion path.
- Schema1 migration validates the actual strict `foundation.1` shape before initializing M1 state. Safe old pose/vitals/tick remain. A newly covered pose relocates to the valid pod deck with feedback. Reads do not write; first successful new save retains the exact old generation as backup. Future/malformed data is refused. Schema2 validates ownership, capacities, equipment, depletion, facilities, findings, vehicle/recovery IDs and berth coherence.
- Bound repair credit is capped at seven patches per hull; sorting fallback never emits public raw materials. Salvage returns only the original public frame investment; bound repair returns stay within maintenance. This prevents repeated rescue from funding optional purchases. The reusable collar/tow remains material-free and requires local staging or attachment.
